AquaSense

Data Deletion Instructions

Last updated: October 22, 2026

To request deletion of your AquaSense account or information, contact the AquaSense administrator who manages your account.

  1. Send the administrator a request from the email address associated with your AquaSense account, or identify that account email in your request.
  2. Specify whether you want your account removed, aquarium information deleted, or both. Do not send your password, access token, or device key.
  3. The administrator will verify the request and tell you when it has been completed or if clarification is needed.

Deleting an authentication account can detach its ownership from an aquarium. Sensor readings and other aquarium records may require a separate deletion decision. The administrator will confirm which records are included in the request before removing them.

Information may remain temporarily in service-provider backups or be retained where required for security or legal reasons. For details about information AquaSense uses, read the Privacy Policy.
